import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 25;
    static final int INF = 10007;
    static final int MAXT = 65;
    static final int MAXC = 12;

    static int n, k;
    static String[] gridA = new String[MAXN];
    static String[] gridB = new String[MAXN];
    static int[][] distToExit = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][][][] memo = new int[MAXT][MAXC][MAXC][MAXC][MAXC];
    static int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static List<int[]> startList = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<int[]> targetList = new ArrayList<>();

    static class Edge {
        int from, to;
        int cap, flow;
        Edge(int from, int to, int cap, int flow) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static class PushRelabel {
        int N;
        List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        List<List<Integer>> adj;
        int[] height, inQueue, count;
        int[] excess;
        Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();

        PushRelabel(int N) {
            this.N = N;
            adj = new ArrayList<>(N);
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            height = new int[N];
            inQueue = new int[N];
            count = new int[N << 1];
            excess = new int[N];
        }

        int addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
            adj.get(u).add(edges.size());
            edges.add(new Edge(u, v, cap, 0));
            adj.get(v).add(edges.size());
            edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
            return adj.get(u).get(adj.get(u).size() - 1);
        }

        void enqueue(int u) {
            if (inQueue[u] == 0 && excess[u] > 0) {
                Q.add(u);
                inQueue[u] = 1;
            }
        }

        void push(int idx) {
            Edge e = edges.get(idx);
            int d = Math.min(e.cap - e.flow, excess[e.from]);
            if (d > 0 && height[e.from] > height[e.to]) {
                e.flow += d;
                excess[e.to] += d;
                excess[e.from] -= d;
                edges.get(idx ^ 1).flow -= d;
                enqueue(e.to);
            }
        }

        void relabel(int u) {
            count[height[u]]--;
            height[u] = 2 * N - 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                Edge e = edges.get(adj.get(u).get(i));
                if (e.cap > e.flow) height[u] = Math.min(height[u], height[e.to]);
            }
            count[++height[u]]++;
        }

        void gapRelabel(int h) {
            for (int u = 0; u < N; u++) {
                if (height[u] >= h && height[u] < N) {
                    count[height[u]]--;
                    height[u] = N;
                    count[N]++;
                    enqueue(u);
                }
            }
        }

        void discharge(int u) {
            for (int i = 0; excess[u] > 0 && i < adj.get(u).size(); i++)
                push(adj.get(u).get(i));
            if (excess[u] > 0) {
                if (height[u] < N && count[height[u]] < 2) gapRelabel(height[u]);
                else relabel(u);
            } else if (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                Q.poll();
                inQueue[u] = 0;
            }
        }

        int getFlow(int src, int snk) {
            height[src] = N;
            inQueue[src] = 1;
            inQueue[snk] = 1;
            count[0] = N - 1;
            count[N] = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < adj.get(src).size(); i++) {
                excess[src] += edges.get(adj.get(src).get(i)).cap;
                push(adj.get(src).get(i));
            }
            while (!Q.isEmpty()) discharge(Q.peek());
            return excess[snk];
        }
    }

    static void bfsFromZ(int sx, int sy) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(distToExit[i], -1);
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        distToExit[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d];
                int ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
                if (distToExit[nx][ny] != -1) continue;
                if (gridB[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Y' || gridB[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Z') continue;
                distToExit[nx][ny] = distToExit[x][y] + 1;
                q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
            }
        }
    }

    static int canReach(int time, int x0, int y0, int x, int y) {
        if (distToExit[x0][y0] < time) return 0;
        if (x0 == x && y0 == y) return 1;
        if (time >= k) return 0;
        if (distToExit[x0][y0] <= time) return 0;
        if (memo[time][x0][y0][x][y] != -1) return memo[time][x0][y0][x][y];
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
            int nx = x0 + dx[d];
            int ny = y0 + dy[d];
            if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
            if (gridA[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Y' || gridA[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Z') continue;
            if (canReach(time + 1, nx, ny, x, y) == 1) {
                memo[time][x0][y0][x][y] = 1;
                return 1;
            }
        }
        memo[time][x0][y0][x][y] = 0;
        return 0;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        // Initialize memo with -1
        for (int a = 0; a < MAXT; a++)
            for (int b = 0; b < MAXC; b++)
                for (int c = 0; c < MAXC; c++)
                    for (int d = 0; d < MAXC; d++)
                        Arrays.fill(memo[a][b][c][d], -1);

        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) gridA[i] = sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) gridB[i] = sc.nextLine();

        int zx = -1, zy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (gridB[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    zx = i;
                    zy = j;
                }

        bfsFromZ(zx, zy);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (distToExit[i][j] == -1) distToExit[i][j] = INF;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = gridA[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') startList.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = gridB[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') targetList.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }

        int S = 0;
        int T = startList.size() + targetList.size() + 1;
        PushRelabel mf = new PushRelabel(T + 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < startList.size(); i++)
            mf.addEdge(S, i + 1, gridA[startList.get(i)[0]].charAt(startList.get(i)[1]) - '0');

        for (int i = 0; i < targetList.size(); i++)
            mf.addEdge(startList.size() + i + 1, T,
                       gridB[targetList.get(i)[0]].charAt(targetList.get(i)[1]) - '0');

        for (int i = 0; i < startList.size(); i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < targetList.size(); j++)
                if (canReach(0, startList.get(i)[0], startList.get(i)[1],
                             targetList.get(j)[0], targetList.get(j)[1]) == 1)
                    mf.addEdge(i + 1, startList.size() + j + 1, INF);

        System.out.println(mf.getFlow(S, T));
        sc.close();
    }
}
